integrity: The analytical proof covers the claimed infinite limit and uniqueness. Numerical quadrature checks supplement but do not establish uniform asymptotics.
scientific_limitations: Fixed 0<rho<1, two specified copula families with matched diagonal power, sufficiently small u, and unique crossing only within 0<v<=u. No uniform endpoint-parameter result or higher-dimensional classification. Historical priority is provisional.
title: Sharp logarithmic reversal of Gaussian and Marshall–Olkin lower-tail rankings
